            '      widget.purchaseIntentStore ?? PurchaseIntentStore();\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Reads the reason stored by a previous paywall visit. Pro users and\n'
            '  /// repeat renders within one session show nothing; the Pro-active body\n'
            '  /// additionally never includes the block.\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadObjectionFollowUp() async {\n'
            '    final reason = await _objectionStore.lastReason();\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    if (!_objectionFollowUp.shouldShow(\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'
            '      reason: reason,\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _objectionFollowUp.markShown();\n'
            '    setState(() => _objectionFollowUpReason = reason);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _trackPaywallSeen(PremiumEntitlements entitlements) {\n'
            '    if (_paywallSeenTracked || entitlements.isPro) return;\n'
            '    _paywallSeenTracked = true;\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallSeen(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: entitlements.isPro,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    PaywallValueSharpeningAnalytics.seen(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '      proofConnected: PaywallValueSharpeningCopy.isProofConnectedSource(\n'
            '        _attributionSource,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    ActivationTracker.trackPaywallShown();\n'
            '    final preview = widget.triggerArgs?.valuePreview;\n'
            '    if (preview != null) {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackProValuePreviewShown(preview.typeId);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    unawaited(First25UserMetrics.trackPaywallSeen(surface: \'paywall_screen\'));\n'
            '    EarlyArchiveProofAnalytics.proScreenOpenedAfterTimeline(\n'
            '      source: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (_attributionSource == PaywallSource.valueMoment) {\n'
            '      RevenueLiftExperimentV2Analytics.paywallSeen(\n'
            '        context: RevenueLiftExperimentV2PaywallSeenContext(\n'
            '          source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '          surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '          entryCount: 0,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _trackPlansShown() {\n'
            '    final monthly = _ps.packageFor(PaywallPlan.monthly);\n'
            '    final yearly = _ps.packageFor(PaywallPlan.yearly);\n'
            '    if (yearly != null) ActivationTracker.trackAnnualPlanShown();\n'
            '    if (monthly != null) ActivationTracker.trackMonthlyPlanShown();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _trackPlanSelected(PaywallPlan plan) {\n'
            '    if (plan == PaywallPlan.yearly) {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackAnnualPlanSelected();\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      ActivationTracker.trackMonthlyPlanSelected();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Stable plan id for analytics — never user text.\n'
            '  String _planIdFor(PaywallPlan plan) => plan == PaywallPlan.yearly\n'
            '      ? PaywallPlanSelectionConfidence.yearlyPlanId\n'
            '      : PaywallPlanSelectionConfidence.monthlyPlanId;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _continue() async {\n'
            '    _purchaseAttemptedThisSession = true;\n'
            '    _recordAttribution(\n'
            '      PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseStarted,\n'
            '      suggestionStage:\n'
            '          SuggestionAttributionEventType.suggestionToPurchaseStarted,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final package = _ps.packageFor(_ps.selectedPlan);\n'
            '    if (package == null) {\n'
            '      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '        const SnackBar(content: Text(SubscriptionCopy.paywallNoOfferings)),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    setState(() {});\n'
            '\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallPurchaseCtaTapped(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    ActivationTracker.trackPaywallContinueTapped();\n'
            '    // Purchase intent: remember the start (stable ids only) and suppress\n'
            '    // the return cue for the rest of this session — cancelling the App\n'
            '    // Store sheet never triggers an immediate nudge.\n'
            '    PurchaseIntentReturnCue.purchaseStartedThisSession = true;\n'
            '    unawaited(\n'
            '      _purchaseIntentStore.recordPurchaseStarted(\n'
            '        source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '        plan: _planIdFor(_ps.selectedPlan),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final period = _ps.selectedPlan == PaywallPlan.monthly\n'
            '        ? \'monthly\'\n'
            '        : \'yearly\';\n'
            '    await First25UserMetrics.trackPaywallStarted(\n'
            '      surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '      period: period,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      final ent = await _paywallController.purchaseSelectedPackage();\n'
            '      if (ent == null) return;\n'
            '      if (ent.isPro) {\n'
            '        unawaited(_purchaseIntentStore.recordPurchaseCompleted());\n'
            '        _recordAttribution(\n'
            '          PaywallAttributionEventType.purchaseCompleted,\n'
            '          suggestionStage:\n'
            '              SuggestionAttributionEventType.suggestionToPurchaseCompleted,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        await First25UserMetrics.trackPaywallPurchased(\n'
            '          surface: \'paywall_screen\',\n'
            '          period: period,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      if (ent.isPro) {\n'
            '        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '          const SnackBar(content: Text(ArchivePaywallCopy.purchaseSuccess)),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        await _load();\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (e, stackTrace) {\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '        SnackBar(\n'
            '          content: Text(\n'
            '            userFacingErrorMessage(\n'
            '              e,\n'
            '              fallback: \'Purchase could not be completed.\',\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() {});\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  RestorePurchasesFlow get _effectiveRestoreFlow =>\n'
            '      widget.restoreFlow ??\n'
            '      (_restoreFlow ??= RestorePurchasesFlow(\n'
            '        billing: AppServices.instance.billing,\n'
            '        isBillingConfigured: () => _restoreBillingReady,\n'
            '      ));\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _restore() async {\n'
            '    _recordAttribution(PaywallAttributionEventType.restoreStarted);\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (!AppServices.isInitialized) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(\n'
            '          const SnackBar(content: Text(RestorePurchasesCopy.restoreError)),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final flow = _effectiveRestoreFlow;\n'
            '    if (flow.isBusy || _ps.isBusy) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    await _paywallController.beginRestore();\n'
            '    if (mounted) setState(() {});\n'
            '    RevenueFunnelAnalytics.paywallRestoreTapped(\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    ActivationTracker.trackRestoreTapped();\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      final result = await flow.restore();\n'
            '      if (!mounted || result.outcome == RestorePurchasesOutcome.skippedBusy) {\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (result.outcome == RestorePurchasesOutcome.restored) {\n'
            '        _recordAttribution(PaywallAttributionEventType.restoreCompleted);\n'
            '        await _load();\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      RestorePurchasesFeedback.showSnackBar(context, result);\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      await _paywallController.endRestore();\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() {});\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Exit paths (back arrow, Done, "Not now") run the one-tap rejection\n'
            '  /// capture first — never shown to Pro users (covers just-purchased) and at\n'
            '  /// most once per session. Navigation always follows; nothing blocks.\n'
            '  Future<void> _dismissWithCapture() async {\n'
            '    await _maybeCaptureRejection();\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    if (context.canPop()) {\n'
            '      context.pop();\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      context.go(\'/record\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _maybeCaptureRejection() async {\n'
            '    if (!PaywallRejectionCapture.shouldPrompt(\n'
            '      isPro: _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true,\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    PaywallRejectionCapture.promptShownThisSession = true;\n'
            '    ActivationFunnelAnalytics.track(\n'
            '      ActivationFunnelAnalytics.paywallRejectionPromptSeen,\n'
            '      source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final result = await showModalBottomSheet<String>(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      builder: (_) => PaywallRejectionPrompt(\n'
            '        source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '        // Persist the stable id so the next paywall visit can answer the\n'
            '        // objection. Never shown in this flow — the screen is popping.\n'
            '        onReason: (reason) => unawaited(\n'
            '          _objectionStore.recordRejection(\n'
            '            reason,\n'
            '            source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    // Swipe/barrier dismissal is a skip too — the prompt logged nothing.\n'
            '    if (result == null) {\n'
            '      ActivationFunnelAnalytics.track(\n'
            '        ActivationFunnelAnalytics.paywallRejectionPromptSkipped,\n'
            '        source: _attributionSource.id,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Header restore action so "Restore purchases" is reachable without\n'
            '  /// scrolling past the rest of the page. Icon-only (tooltip carries the\n'
            '  /// visible label) so it never duplicates the bottom text button\'s label\n'
            '  /// for `find.text` uniqueness in existing tests.\n'
            '  Widget? _headerRestoreAction() {\n'
            '    if (_ps.loadingOfferings || _ps.entitlements?.isPro == true) return null;\n'
            '    return IconButton(\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'paywall_header_restore_action\'),\n'
            '      icon: const Icon(Icons.restore),\n'
            '      tooltip: ConsumerUiCopy.restorePurchases,\n'
            '      onPressed: _ps.isBusy ? null : _restore,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    if (!_delayedPaywallGateResolved) {\n'
            '      return const SizedBox.shrink();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final restoreAction = _headerRestoreAction();\n'
            '    return PushedScreenShell(\n'
            '      title: _entitlementLabel,\n'
            '      onBack: () => unawaited(_dismissWithCapture()),\n'
            '      showBottomDone: false,\n'
            '      actions: restoreAction == null ? null : [restoreAction],\n'
            '      body: _paywallShellBody(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _paywallShellBody() {\n'
            '    if (_ps.loadingOfferings) {\n'
            '      return ListView(\n'
            '        padding: ArchiveResponsiveLayout.pagePadding(context),\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 32),\n'
            '            child: Column(\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                Text(\n'
            '                  ArchivePaywallCopy.checkingProAccess,\n'
            '                  style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveBody(context),\n'
            '                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (_ps.entitlements?.isPro == true) {\n'
            '      return ListView(\n'
            '        padding: ArchiveResponsiveLayout.pagePadding(context),\n'
            '        children: [_proActiveBody()],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (ScreenshotMode.enabled) {\n'
            '      return ListView(\n'
            '        padding: ArchiveResponsiveLayout.pagePadding(context),\n'
            '        children: [_screenshotPaywallBody()],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!_purchasePlansAvailable) {\n'
            '      return ListView(\n'
            '        padding: ArchiveResponsiveLayout.pagePadding(context),\n'
            '        children: [_unavailableBody()],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return _paywallBody();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _proActiveBody() {\n'
            '    return Builder(\n'
            '      builder: (context) => Column(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '          const Icon(\n'
            '            Icons.verified_outlined,\n'
            '            size: 48,\n'
            '            color: VoiceMemoryColors.success,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            ArchivePaywallCopy.proActiveTitle,\n'
            '            style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveSectionTitle(context),\n'
            '            textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            ArchivePaywallCopy.proActiveConfirmation,\n'
            '            style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveBody(context),\n'
            '            textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          OutlinedButton(\n'
            '            onPressed: () => context.pop(),\n'
            '            child: Text(context.l10n.paywallBackToPatterns),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _unavailableBody() {\n'
            '    final sourceCopy = _sourceCopy;\n'
            '    final packaging = _packaging;\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        PaywallUnavailableFallback(\n'
            '          headline: sourceCopy?.headline ?? ConsumerUiCopy.paywallHeadline,\n'
            '          body: _unavailableBodyText,\n'
            '          busy: _ps.isBusy,\n'
            '          retrying: _ps.offeringsReloading,\n'
            '          showRetry: _billingReady,\n'
            '          onRetry: () => unawaited(_load(isRetry: true)),\n'
            '          onRestore: _restore,\n'
            '          onDismiss: () => unawaited(_dismissWithCapture()),\n'
            '          primaryDismissLabel: packaging.continueCta,\n'
            '          hideBenefits: true,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        if (_objectionFollowUpReason != null) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '          _aboveFoldClaritySection(),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '          _objectionFollowUpSection(),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        if (_paywallObjectionSectionResult.shouldShow) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '          _paywallObjectionSection(),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        if (_showsPurchaseConfidenceCard) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '          _purchaseConfidenceSection(),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '        _subscriptionDetailsSection(plansAvailable: false),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Long-term archive framing near the plan cards — addresses subscription\n'
            '  /// resistance by being honest about what kind of product this is.\n'
            '  Widget _longTermArchiveLine() {\n'
            '    return Text(\n'
            '      PaywallAnnualValueCopy.longTermLine,\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'paywall_long_term_line\'),\n'
            '      textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '      style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// "Proof you can look for" — observable checks so the user can judge for\n'
            '  /// themselves whether Pro is helping. Suggestion sources only.\n'
            '  Widget _proofPreviewSection() {\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'paywall_proof_preview\'),\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        color: VoiceMemoryColors.surface,\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),\n'
            '        border: Border.all(color: VoiceMemoryColors.border),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: Column(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            PaywallProofPreview.heading,\n'
            '            style: ArchiveMobileTypography.listTitle(context),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          for (final row in PaywallProofPreview.rows) ...[\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                const Icon(\n'
            '                  Icons.visibility_outlined,\n'
            '                  size: 16,\n'
            '                  color: VoiceMemoryColors.primaryIndigo,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: Text(\n'
            '                    row,\n'
            '                    style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// True only when one of the loaded App Store products carries an actual\n'
            '  /// zero-price introductory offer. No offerings (or paid intro pricing)\n'
            '  /// means no trial copy — the line is never a generic promise.\n'
            '  bool get _hasFreeTrialOffer {\n'
            '    for (final plan in PaywallPlan.values) {\n'
            '      final intro = _ps.packageFor(plan)?.storeProduct.introductoryPrice;\n'
            '      if (intro != null && intro.price == 0) return true;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return false;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Above-fold clarity: the paid promise in plain words, directly under\n'
            '  /// the headline and before any plan card or CTA. Same block for every\n'
            '  /// source so the continuity framing lives in one place.\n'
            '  Widget _aboveFoldClaritySection() {\n'
            '    ActivationFunnelAnalytics.track(\n'
            '      ActivationFunnelAnalytics.paywallAboveFoldClaritySeen,\n'
            '      source: widget.triggerArgs?.source?.id,\n'
            '      oncePerSession: true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return Builder(\n'
            '      builder: (context) => Container(\n'
            '        key: const Key(\'paywall_above_fold_clarity\'),\n'
            '        width: double.infinity,\n'
            '        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),\n'
            '        decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '          color: VoiceMemoryColors.surface,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),\n'
            '          border: Border.all(color: VoiceMemoryColors.border),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              PaywallAboveFoldClarity.title,\n'
            '              style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveSectionTitle(context),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '            for (final line in PaywallAboveFoldClarity.lines)\n'
            '              Padding(\n'
            '                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                  children: [\n'
            '                    const Icon(\n'
            '                      Icons.check_circle_outline,\n'
            '                      size: 18,\n'
            '                      color: VoiceMemoryColors.primaryIndigo,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      child: Text(\n'
            '                        line,\n'
            '                        style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveBody(context),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              PaywallAboveFoldClarity.freeReassuranceLine,\n'
            '              style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// One objection-specific reassurance block — only on a paywall visit\n'
            '  /// after a rejection reason was captured, below the above-fold clarity\n'
            '  /// block and above the plan cards. The CTA is untouched.\n'
            '  Widget _objectionFollowUpSection() {\n'
            '    return PaywallObjectionFollowUpCard(\n'
            '      reason: _objectionFollowUpReason!,\n'
            '      source: widget.triggerArgs?.source?.id,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Price confidence immediately below the plan cards: manage-anytime,\n'
            '  /// plus the trial handling line only when a real free trial was detected\n'
            '  /// on a loaded product. Reduces hesitation at the App Store sheet.\n'
            '  Widget _priceConfidenceLines() {\n'
            '    ActivationFunnelAnalytics.track(\n'
            '      ActivationFunnelAnalytics.priceConfidenceSeen,\n'
            '      source: widget.triggerArgs?.source?.id,\n'
            '      oncePerSession: true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'paywall_price_confidence\'),\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        for (final line in PaywallPriceConfidenceCopy.planLines(\n'
            '          hasFreeTrial: _hasFreeTrialOffer,\n'
            '        ))\n'
            '          Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),\n'
            '            child: Text(\n'
            '              line,\n'
            '              textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '              style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Final price-confidence line directly before the purchase CTA — the App\n'
            '  /// Store confirms before anything is charged.\n'
            '  Widget _appStoreConfirmLine() {\n'
            '    return Text(\n'
            '      PaywallPriceConfidenceCopy.confirmLine,\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'paywall_app_store_confirm_line\'),\n'
            '      textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '      style: ArchiveMobileTypography.responsiveHelper(context),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _paywallDifferentiationAndTrustSection({\n'
            '    bool includeTrustLine = true,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    return Builder(\n'
            '      builder: (context) => Column(\n'
            '        key: const Key(\'paywall_differentiation_trust\'),\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          Text(\n'
